title.en: An Act to Provide for the Sale of Leprosy Drugs

text.en:
The Secretary of Public Instruction shall, at his discretion, and under such restrictions as he may
deem advisable, permit the sale to private parties of drugs manufactured by the Government for the treatment
of leprosy, and to fix the price for the same.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
